'''Jerzy Marian Langer''' (born 18 July 1947, Łódź, Poland) is a [[Polish people|Polish]] [[physicist]] specializing in [[condensed matter physics]]. He is a professor at the Institute of Physics of the [[Polish Academy of Sciences]].<ref name="cv">[http://www.ae-info.org/ae/User/Langer_Jerzy/CV Curriculum vitae], [[Academia Europaea]], retrieved 2014-05-05.</ref> Langer is currently an Ambassador for the [[European Innovation Council]] for the years 2021-2027.<ref>{{Cite web |title=EIC Ambassadors (2021 – 2027) |url=https://eic.ec.europa.eu/eic-ambassadors-2021-2027_en |access-date=31 July 2022 |website=European Innovation Council}}</ref>

==Awards and honors==
Langer became a [[fellow]] of the [[American Physical Society]] in 1989 "for contributions in the area of defects and recombination phenomena in semiconductors and ionic solids."<ref>[http://www.aps.org/programs/honors/fellowships/archive-all.cfm?initial=L&year=2013&unit_id=&institution= APS Fellow Archive], accessed 2014-05-06.</ref> He is also a fellow of the [[Warsaw Scientific Society]],<ref>[http://www.tnw.waw.pl/index.php?option=com_content&task=view&id=71&Itemid=34 Member list] {{Webarchive|url=https://web.archive.org/web/20140507045332/http://www.tnw.waw.pl/index.php?option=com_content&task=view&id=71&Itemid=34 |date=2014-05-07 }}, Warsaw Scientific Society (in Polish), retrieved 2014-05-06.</ref> and [[Academia Europaea]].<ref name="cv"/>
